title: bentopdf values
description: Strict values schema (issue #68). additionalProperties is false on every chart-owned object level, so a key that the chart does not read is rejected at render time instead of being silently ignored. The only objects that stay open are the ones the chart passes through verbatim (probes, security contexts, global, the Ingress annotation map and bentopdf.config) - the chart does not interpret their contents, so it cannot judge which keys are meaningful.

global.description: Helm's conventional cross-chart values. Unused by this chart, kept open so an umbrella install cannot break on it.

config.description: The body of /usr/share/nginx/html/config.json. Deliberately open: the schema of that file is upstream's (today disabledTools and editorDisabledCategories), and restricting it here would only reject keys the upstream has not invented yet. Typed as object/null rather than left untyped because the chart renders it with toJson - a scalar here would produce valid JSON that configures nothing; the helper rejects it with a message naming the values path.

annotations.description: Extra Ingress annotations, merged with the cert-manager annotation the chart always sets. Free-form keys by nature.

resources.description: May be null / empty: the chart then falls back to its default requests and computed limits (issue #99) instead of rendering a container without resource accounting.

securityContext.description: May be null / empty at any level: the chart then falls back to its hardening defaults (issue #99) instead of rendering an unhardened workload.

pod.description: Merged onto the chart's pod hardening defaults and rendered as the pod's securityContext; kept open because the chart does not interpret the individual fields.

container.description: Merged onto the chart's container hardening defaults and rendered as the container's securityContext; kept open because the chart does not interpret the individual fields. Setting readOnlyRootFilesystem to false is the deliberate escape hatch for the three image env switches that rewrite files with sed (PORT, DISABLE_IPV6, ROBOTS_NOINDEX) - see values.yaml.

probe.description: Merged onto the chart's probe defaults and rendered as a container probe; kept open because the chart does not interpret the individual fields. May be null / empty, which means the defaults apply (issue #99) rather than the probe disappearing.
